cells.gaps: No source found says every birth registered across the country receives the number; the PRODIGY pilot covered Antananarivo and Toamasina only.
cells.note: The World Bank reports that a PRODIGY pilot in Antananarivo and Toamasina registered over 3,000 newborns and issued birth certificates with a unique identification number (October 2023): the number given at registration in part of the country, stage 3. Nothing shows it given nationally, so not stage 4.
